source.title: Contextual and pure time coding for self and other in the hippocampus.

confidence_rationale: Direct single-unit evidence for the exact distinction MECH-148 needs -- a population of CA1 cells encoding PURE elapsed time independent of spatial context, dissociated from context-conjunctive time cells. The social-landing time cells are a bonus that grounds the V5/MECH-127 multi-agent-credit bridge the node flags.
failure_signatures: The pure-time signal is demonstrated in bat CA1 during hanging/landing epochs; whether an analogous context-independent elapsed-time tag is necessary for credit assignment over MULTI-STEP planning rollouts (REE's use) is not tested -- the paper is about representation, not about its use in valuation.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Bat hippocampal CA1 contains two distinct time-cell populations: contextual time cells (different temporal sequences at different locations) and PURE time cells (similar preferred times across contexts, encoding elapsed time per se). A further population encodes time aligned to ANOTHER bat's landing.
mapping.ree_translation: Direct grounding for MECH-148's context-independent elapsed-time scaffold: the pure-time population is exactly the 'context-independent elapsed-time encoding' MECH-148 requires for E3 to weight rollout outcomes by temporal distance rather than being step-local-myopic. The other-aligned time cells ground the social variant the node names as the MECH-127 multi-agent temporal-credit bridge toward V5.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Demonstrates the REPRESENTATION (pure elapsed-time cells exist and are dissociable); does not demonstrate that wiring such a tag into a planner improves long-horizon credit assignment. REE's use of the signal for discounting is the inference.
mapping.source_context: Single-unit recordings in freely-behaving Egyptian fruit bats, CA1, during stationary hanging epochs and a social imitation/landing task.

confidence_components.notes: Nature Neuroscience primary single-unit data; the pure-vs-contextual dissociation maps almost verbatim onto MECH-148's construct. Transfer risk moderate (bat CA1 -> REE rollout module).
